(3) The music continues as the male voice speaks 'Not too bad' in a calm, slightly deep, and satisfied tone. A digital 'ding' chime sound effect triggers simultaneously with a visual overlay. (4) The BGM cuts out. A loud, aggressive, and highly accented male voice (portraying a father) shouts 'What do you mean not too bad? Your cousin got A++!'. The tone is sharp and authoritative. It highlights the contrast between self-satisfaction with a mediocre result ('B-') and the intense pressure of familial expectations, culminating in the popular 'Emotional Damage' meme to provide a punchline.
